name: calc_f64

test_list.description: The float evaluator permits documented transcendental operators, rejects unknown identifiers, and applies the configured power exponent bound.
The floating-point calculator enforces the configured exponent magnitude bound for parenthesized arithmetic and right-associative power expressions while retaining valid in-range exponents.
Exponent validation preserves supported whitespace-separated unary function syntax and Unicode constants.
The configured nesting bound also limits recursive whitespace-separated prefix functions inside an exponent.
The configured nesting bound limits right-associative exponent chains even without parentheses.
A zero parser depth bound rejects float expressions consistently with the decimal evaluator.

inputs.name: expr
inputs.description: A bounded expression containing only documented constants, operators, and functions.

inputs.name: limits
inputs.description: Expression length, nesting, and power exponent limits.

output_description: A finite floating-point result or a typed parse, range, exponent, or nonfinite error.
